evidence: The text mentions the use of Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) images of graphene with respect to the number of Pt ALD cycles. Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) analysis was performed to observe the Pt deposition on the grain boundaries. Selected Area Diffraction Patterns (SADPs) were collected from the same region in the bright-field TEM image. Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) images confirmed the selective deposition through the increase in the heights of the lines. X-ray Photoemission Spectroscopy (XPS) analysis was performed to obtain the chemical information of graphene. Hall Effect Measurement was used to characterize the electrical properties of graphene. Optical Transmittance Measurement was used to measure the optical transmittance at 550 nm. X-ray Reflectometry (XRR) analysis was conducted to measure the thickness of the Pt film on the SiO2 substrate. Fourier Transform (FFT) was used in the high-resolution TEM image. UV Photoelectron Spectroscopy (UPS) was used to measure the work function of graphene.
